newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU farm council to discuss new flax aid controls.
newsitem.headline: EU farm council to discuss new flax aid controls.

text.p: European Union farm ministers will be asked to approve new controls on the payment of aid to flax producers at next week's farm council, an EU diplomat said.
New controls on the payments were agreed on Tuesday by EU diplomats at a special agriculture committee meeting.
The proposal to link payment of aid to contracts with processors follows allegations that some producers had been claiming aid for crops that were never harvested.
"Aid for the 1996/97 marketing year is put at an average for the EU of 865.47 Ecus per hectare, which is obviously an incentive to fraud," the diplomat said.
Although agreement was reached, there were objections.
The item will be listed for discussion at the council so that the Spanish minister can make a statement.
